title: The Tell-Tale Heart
author: Edgar Allan Poe
summary: An unnamed narrator insists he is sane while he describes murdering the old man he lives with because of the man's pale eye. Then the sound of a beating heart begins to haunt him.
readIf: you want a quick classic of psychological horror to read in one sitting.
skipIf: you prefer long, slow-building stories or dislike a disturbed narrator's inner voice.
